title: Nouns Cola AI posters · set 02
dek: Four new individual Nouns Cola advertisements generated with ChatGPT image generation: hero, night, pop, and mural.
body:
Another set of Nouns Cola advertisements is live, this time as individual posters instead of a single concept board.

The useful shift is focus. Each generated image has to stand on its own: one hero statement, one city-night version, one color-pop poster, one mural-world artifact. That makes the campaign language easier to test because each piece can be evaluated like an actual placement instead of a mood cloud.

This is what AI is particularly good for in the Nouns Cola project: fast format variation with enough finish to make the next judgment call sharper. Which poster feels like launch? Which one belongs on a wall? Which one belongs in a retailer packet? The set makes those questions visible.
